verdicts.line: Again. Louder, new face. Make them look at you.
verdicts.why: Texture and Cross's own dialogue; 'new face' is his term of address, allowed under the rule.
show_when_blocked plus cooldown_message: out of its slot the row stays on the Theatre as a dimmed line with its hours (v2.py:6716-6720, onlyTheClockShut v2.py:6079 drops the weekday and time items).
A class she chooses now carries its hours as a greyed line; hidden only until met_cross, which is a flag, not the clock (onlyTheClockShut returns false, no locked_text, so hidden: v2.py:6716-6727).
Its exit states its time; no 3-minute default applies.
Windowed work no longer vanishes out of hours once she's met Cross.
End exclusive: starts 11:00-11:29, matching 'at 11am'; Cross's row runs to 13:00, so the 120-minute class ends inside his presence.
